latestReleaseNotes:
### Release info
Oobee is available as a desktop app for Mac and Windows. The setup files can be downloaded under `Assets` at the bottom of the page.

### Installation Guide
* Refer to the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/blob/master/INSTALLATION.md) for Windows and Mac.

### What's New
In this release, Google Safe Browsing is introduced to protect users against scanning malware, phishing and unwanted pages. Other miscellaneous UI bug fixes are included.

#### Features
* feat: add Google Safe Browsing protection (Linux, Mac, Windows) when scans are run on Google Chrome by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/793 and https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/commit/e11caecab5c4647094c05958b5bbbcfe54fd6fbc and https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/commit/ab6158f624ecff03134440375a8e754784db9515
* feat(updater): drive release catalog and artifact names from latest-release.json by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/271

#### Improvements
* improv: omit passed items from disk writes to reduce storage usage by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/773
* Upgrade crawlee and playwright versions for stability on Windows by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/776
* Restore native constructors before running axe by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/797

#### Fixes
* Open error log files in external text editor by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/commit/01d326885f7ee905e601f1fe27f8d4664c2de134
* Fixes custom flow cancel button does not cancel scan by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/commit/c2e4a6f5dffea956691d7adc4e1cfbe4a7f809d7
* fix: parse embedded userinfo from proxy env URLs by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/798
* fix: make `waitForPageLoaded` actually wait for the DOM to be ready by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/803
* Fix/rate controller double halve and recovery by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/806
* fix(crawler): use axe's stored sub-rect for target-size enrichment by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/804
* fix: accessible-label false positives, Details section for two ARIA rules, correct report title by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/809
* Fix/Reduce hydration-timing false positives (target-size, color-contrast, aria-hidden-focus) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/814
* Bump websocket-driver from 0.7.4 to 0.7.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/257
* Bump axios from 1.17.0 to 1.18.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/258
* chore(deps): bump immutable from 5.1.6 to 5.1.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/261
* chore(deps-dev): bump fast-uri from 3.1.2 to 3.1.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/262
* chore(deps-dev): bump shell-quote from 1.8.4 to 1.10.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/263
* chore(deps): bump ip-address from 10.2.0 to 10.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/265
* chore(deps-dev): bump fast-uri from 3.1.4 to 3.1.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/267
* chore(deps): bump brace-expansion from 1.1.16 to 1.1.18 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/268
* chore: bump to v0.11.7 and migrate to react-router@8 (drop react-router-dom) by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/269
* fix(update-prompt): reliably detect Admin By Request elevation on macOS by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/270
* fix(update-prompt): skip ABR admin check when app bundle is user-writable by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/272

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/compare/0.11.1...0.11.7
